scope: One-thread CPU perf_counter intervals, zero_grad through AdamWstep. Core includes token interface, temporal operations, keys/writes and message/state processing. Readout is exact adaptive NLL. Backward covers all gradients; optimizer separate. Other covers teacher sampling/weighting, reductions, clipping and in-step diagnostics. Preprocessing/evaluation/post-step diagnostics/serialization excluded. Wrappers add timing overhead; arithmetic trace wall is not used. No hardware energy, FLOP reduction or quality gain inferred.
